verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core product IS an AI agent you delegate to via natural-language prompts to complete multi-step browser tasks (skyvern-docs-17, skyvern-docs-18), and it also ships a 'Copilot chat for building and debugging workflows interactively' inside the platform (skyvern-docs-25), plus SOP-to-workflow generation from plain English (skyvern-docs-24). This matches an AI-native user delegating tasks to a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the copilot chat feature specifically (community evidence focuses on task execution quality, not the assistant/copilot UX), and no detail on assistant's conversational scope beyond workflow authoring.
